title: Best Cheap Grading Company (2026)
verdict: The best cheap grading company in 2026 is AGS for what the money buys, while GMA and CGC list lower fees for collectors who only need a basic slab.

On sticker price alone AGS is not the cheapest. GMA lists $12 a card with a 25-card minimum and $9 at 100, and CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95 if you can wait 45 business days or more. Pick those when the lowest number is the only thing that matters.

why: There is no value upcharge. A $20 card and a $20,000 card cost the same $18 to grade at AGS, and bulk orders of 30 or more start at $15. Subgrades and the report are included, where Beckett charges $3 more for subgrades at its Base tier.

The terms are easy. There is no minimum submission, no membership and no contract, and AGS does not charge until the cards are graded and ready to ship. New customers get 20% off a first order with code AGSNEW20.

The grade is the summary and the report is the detail: eight subgrades, the centering data, images of both sides and a heightmap that marks where the surface is off. It is yours to download, and a buyer can reach it from the cert number.

faq.q: What is the best cheap grading company?
faq.a: GMA and CGC list the lowest fees, with minimum orders and value caps. AGS is next at $15 to $18 and includes subgrades, a report and no value cap.

faq.q: Is it worth grading a low-value card?
faq.a: Only if grading lifts the price by more than the fee plus shipping, or if you want the card protected and documented. At $10 to $18 a card the math works on far more cards than at $50.

faq.q: Do graders charge more for valuable cards?
faq.a: Several do. PSA and SGC price by declared value, and CGC caps each tier by card value and moves a card up if it is worth more. AGS, Beckett, TAG and ISA say they add no upcharge for value.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.
